EXTENSION_SQL.query:
WITH members AS (
 SELECT e.extname,d.classid,d.objid,d.objsubid,i.type,i.schema,i.identity,
 CASE d.classid WHEN 'pg_proc'::regclass THEN p.proowner WHEN 'pg_type'::regclass THEN t.typowner
 WHEN 'pg_operator'::regclass THEN o.oprowner WHEN 'pg_opclass'::regclass THEN c.opcowner
 WHEN 'pg_opfamily'::regclass THEN f.opfowner END AS ownerid,
 CASE d.classid WHEN 'pg_proc'::regclass THEN p.proacl WHEN 'pg_type'::regclass THEN t.typacl END AS rawacl,
 CASE d.classid
 WHEN 'pg_proc'::regclass THEN jsonb_build_object('definition',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'kind',p.prokind,'returnType',p.prorettype::regtype::text,'set',p.proretset,'securityDefiner',p.prosecdef,'strict',p.proisstrict,'volatility',p.provolatile,'parallel',p.proparallel,'leakproof',p.proleakproof,'language',(SELECT lanname FROM pg_language WHERE oid=p.prolang),'src',p.prosrc,'bin',p.probin,'config',p.proconfig,'argnames',p.proargnames,'argmodes',p.proargmodes,'arguments',pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid),'cost',p.procost,'rows',p.prorows)
 WHEN 'pg_type'::regclass THEN jsonb_build_object('type',t.typtype,'category',t.typcategory,'defined',t.typisdefined,'len',t.typlen,'byval',t.typbyval,'align',t.typalign,'storage',t.typstorage,'input',t.typinput::regprocedure::text,'output',t.typoutput::regprocedure::text,'receive',t.typreceive::regprocedure::text,'send',t.typsend::regprocedure::text,'typmodin',t.typmodin::regprocedure::text,'typmodout',t.typmodout::regprocedure::text,'analyze',t.typanalyze::regprocedure::text,'subscript',t.typsubscript::regprocedure::text,'element',t.typelem::regtype::text,'array',t.typarray::regtype::text,'base',t.typbasetype::regtype::text,'notnull',t.typnotnull,'default',t.typdefault)
 WHEN 'pg_operator'::regclass THEN jsonb_build_object('kind',o.oprkind,'merge',o.oprcanmerge,'hash',o.oprcanhash,'left',o.oprleft::regtype::text,'right',o.oprright::regtype::text,'result',o.oprresult::regtype::text,'code',o.oprcode::regprocedure::text,'commutator',o.oprcom::regoperator::text,'negator',o.oprnegate::regoperator::text,'restrict',o.oprrest::regprocedure::text,'join',o.oprjoin::regprocedure::text)
 WHEN 'pg_opclass'::regclass THEN jsonb_build_object('method',(SELECT amname FROM pg_am WHERE oid=c.opcmethod),'family',(SELECT format('%I.%I',n.nspname,q.opfname) FROM pg_opfamily q JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=q.opfnamespace WHERE q.oid=c.opcfamily),'input',c.opcintype::regtype::text,'key',c.opckeytype::regtype::text,'default',c.opcdefault)
 WHEN 'pg_opfamily'::regclass THEN jsonb_build_object('method',(SELECT amname FROM pg_am WHERE oid=f.opfmethod),'operators',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(a.amoplefttype::regtype::text,a.amoprighttype::regtype::text,a.amopstrategy,a.amoppurpose,a.amopopr::regoperator::text) ORDER BY a.amoplefttype::regtype::text,a.amoprighttype::regtype::text,a.amopstrategy),'[]') FROM pg_amop a WHERE a.amopfamily=f.oid),'procedures',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(a.amproclefttype::regtype::text,a.amprocrighttype::regtype::text,a.amprocnum,a.amproc::regprocedure::text) ORDER BY a.amproclefttype::regtype::text,a.amprocrighttype::regtype::text,a.amprocnum),'[]') FROM pg_amproc a WHERE a.amprocfamily=f.oid))
 END AS structure
 FROM pg_depend d JOIN pg_extension e ON e.oid=d.refobjid
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_identify_object(d.classid,d.objid,d.objsubid) i
 LEFT JOIN pg_proc p ON d.classid='pg_proc'::regclass AND p.oid=d.objid
 LEFT JOIN pg_type t ON d.classid='pg_type'::regclass AND t.oid=d.objid
 LEFT JOIN pg_operator o ON d.classid='pg_operator'::regclass AND o.oid=d.objid
 LEFT JOIN pg_opclass c ON d.classid='pg_opclass'::regclass AND c.oid=d.objid
 LEFT JOIN pg_opfamily f ON d.classid='pg_opfamily'::regclass AND f.oid=d.objid
 WHERE d.refclassid='pg_extension'::regclass AND d.deptype='e' AND e.extname<>'plpgsql'
), aclmembers AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN classid='pg_proc'::regclass THEN 'f' ELSE 'T' END::"char" AS defaulttype FROM members WHERE classid IN ('pg_proc'::regclass,'pg_type'::regclass))
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'extensions',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',e.extname,'version',e.extversion,'schema',n.nspname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(e.extowner),'relocatable',e.extrelocatable,'dependencies',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.extname ORDER BY x.extname),'[]') FROM pg_depend d JOIN pg_extension x ON x.oid=d.refobjid WHERE d.classid='pg_extension'::regclass AND d.objid=e.oid AND d.refclassid='pg_extension'::regclass),'configTables',(SELECT jsonb_agg(x::regclass::text ORDER BY ord) FROM unnest(e.extconfig) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(x,ord)),'conditions',e.extcondition) ORDER BY e.extname),'[]') FROM pg_extension e JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=e.extnamespace WHERE e.extname<>'plpgsql'),
 'members',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('extension',extname,'class',classid::regclass::text,'objectType',type,'schema',schema,'identity',identity,'subid',objsubid,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(ownerid),'structure',structure) ORDER BY extname,classid::regclass::text,identity,objsubid),'[]') FROM members),
 'rawAcl',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(extname,classid::regclass::text,identity,pg_get_userbyid(ownerid),rawacl) ORDER BY extname,classid::regclass::text,identity),'[]') FROM aclmembers),
 'expandedAcl',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(m.extname,m.classid::regclass::text,m.identity,pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee)::text END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable) ORDER BY m.extname,m.classid::regclass::text,m.identity,pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee)::text END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable),'[]') FROM aclmembers m CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(m.rawacl,acldefault(m.defaulttype,m.ownerid))) a),
 'effective',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(m.extname,m.classid::regclass::text,m.identity,r.rolname,CASE WHEN m.classid='pg_proc'::regclass THEN has_function_privilege(r.oid,m.objid,'EXECUTE') ELSE has_type_privilege(r.oid,m.objid,'USAGE') END) ORDER BY m.extname,m.classid::regclass::text,m.identity,r.rolname),'[]') FROM aclmembers m CROSS JOIN pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname<>'uply_owned_restore_admin'),
 'initialPrivileges',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('extension',m.extname,'class',m.classid::regclass::text,'identity',m.identity,'subid',ip.objsubid,'origin',ip.privtype,'raw',ip.initprivs,'expanded',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee)::text END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable) ORDER BY pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee)::text END,a.privilege_type) FROM aclexplode(ip.initprivs) a)) ORDER BY m.extname,m.classid::regclass::text,m.identity,ip.objsubid),'[]') FROM members m JOIN pg_init_privs ip ON ip.classoid=m.classid AND ip.objoid=m.objid)
);

GLOBAL_ROLE_SETTINGS_SQL.query: SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(r.rolname,s.setdatabase,s.setconfig) ORDER BY r.rolname,s.setdatabase),'[]') FROM pg_db_role_setting s JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=s.setrole;

LOCALE_SQL.query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('version',current_setting('server_version'),'versionNum',current_setting('server_version_num'),'encoding',pg_encoding_to_char(d.encoding),'collate',d.datcollate,'ctype',d.datctype,'provider',d.datlocprovider,'locale',d.datlocale) FROM pg_database d WHERE datname=current_database();

RELATION_DATA_SQL.query: SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('identity',format('%I.%I',n.nspname,c.relname),'kind',c.relkind,'query',format('SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(v ORDER BY v::text),''[]''::jsonb) FROM (SELECT to_jsonb(t) AS v FROM %I.%I AS t) q;',n.nspname,c.relname)) ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname),'[]') FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE c.relkind IN ('r','m') AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema';

SEQUENCE_SQL.query: SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('identity',format('%I.%I',n.nspname,c.relname),'query',format('SELECT jsonb_build_array(last_value::text,is_called) FROM %I.%I;',n.nspname,c.relname)) ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname),'[]') FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE c.relkind='S' AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema';

d8_databaseAcl.query:
SELECT jsonb_build_object('name',datname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(datdba),'aclRaw',datacl::text,
 'effectiveAcl',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable) ORDER BY pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable),'[]') FROM aclexplode(coalesce(datacl,acldefault('d',datdba))) a)) FROM pg_database WHERE datname=current_database();

d8_effectivePrivileges.query:
SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(r.rolname,
 has_schema_privilege(r.oid,'uply_d8','USAGE'),has_schema_privilege(r.oid,'uply_d8','CREATE'),
 has_table_privilege(r.oid,'uply_d8.samples','SELECT'),has_table_privilege(r.oid,'uply_d8.samples','INSERT'),
 has_column_privilege(r.oid,'uply_d8.samples','nullable_text','SELECT'),
 has_sequence_privilege(r.oid,'uply_d8.sample_seq','USAGE'),
 has_function_privilege(r.oid,'uply_d8.render_label(text)','EXECUTE'),
 has_type_privilege(r.oid,'uply_d8.state','USAGE')) ORDER BY r.rolname),'[]')
 FROM pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname IN ('postgres','uply_d8_member','uply_d8_target','anon','authenticated','service_role','uply_d8_source_bootstrap');

d8_extensions.query:
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'extensions',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(e.extname,e.extversion,n.nspname,pg_get_userbyid(e.extowner)) ORDER BY e.extname),'[]') FROM pg_extension e JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=e.extnamespace),
 'plpgsqlLanguage',(SELECT jsonb_build_array(l.lanname,pg_get_userbyid(l.lanowner),l.lanpltrusted,l.lanacl::text,lh.proname,ih.proname,vh.proname) FROM pg_language l LEFT JOIN pg_proc lh ON lh.oid=l.lanplcallfoid LEFT JOIN pg_proc ih ON ih.oid=l.laninline LEFT JOIN pg_proc vh ON vh.oid=l.lanvalidator WHERE l.lanname='plpgsql'),
 'members',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(i.type,i.schema,i.name,i.identity,d.objsubid) ORDER BY i.type,i.schema,i.name,i.identity,d.objsubid),'[]') FROM pg_depend d JOIN pg_extension e ON e.oid=d.refobjid CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_identify_object(d.classid,d.objid,d.objsubid) i WHERE d.refclassid='pg_extension'::regclass AND d.deptype='e' AND e.extname='plpgsql'),
 'implementation',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,p.proname,oidvectortypes(p.proargtypes),pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),p.proacl::text,p.prokind,p.prorettype::regtype::text,p.proretset,p.prosecdef,p.proisstrict,p.provolatile,p.proparallel,p.proleakproof,l.lanname,p.prosrc,p.probin,p.proconfig,p.proargnames,p.proargmodes) ORDER BY n.nspname,p.proname,oidvectortypes(p.proargtypes)),'[]') FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang JOIN pg_depend d ON d.classid='pg_proc'::regclass AND d.objid=p.oid AND d.objsubid=0 AND d.deptype='e' AND d.refclassid='pg_extension'::regclass JOIN pg_extension e ON e.oid=d.refobjid WHERE e.extname='plpgsql'));

d8_objectCounts.query: SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,c.relkind,x.cnt) ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relkind),'[]') FROM (SELECT relnamespace,relkind,count(*) cnt FROM pg_class GROUP BY relnamespace,relkind) x JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=x.relnamespace CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.relkind) c WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema';

d8_objectOwners.query: SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,c.relname,c.relkind,pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner)) ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname),'[]') FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema';

d8_rawExpandedAcl.query:
WITH objects(kind,ident,ownerid,rawacl,defaulttype) AS (
 SELECT 'function',n.nspname||'.'||p.proname||'('||oidvectortypes(p.proargtypes)||')',p.proowner,p.proacl,'f'::"char" FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE (n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_depend d JOIN pg_extension e ON e.oid=d.refobjid WHERE d.classid='pg_proc'::regclass AND d.objid=p.oid AND d.deptype='e' AND d.refclassid='pg_extension'::regclass AND e.extname='plpgsql')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'relation',n.nspname||'.'||c.relname,c.relowner,c.relacl,CASE WHEN c.relkind='S' THEN 'S' ELSE 'r' END::"char" FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'column',n.nspname||'.'||c.relname||'.'||a.attname,c.relowner,a.attacl,'c'::"char" FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'namespace',nspname,nspowner,nspacl,'n'::"char" FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND nspname<>'information_schema'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'type',n.nspname||'.'||t.typname,t.typowner,t.typacl,'T'::"char" FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema' AND (t.typtype IN ('e','d') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_class c WHERE c.reltype=t.oid))
 UNION ALL SELECT 'default',pg_get_userbyid(a.defaclrole)||':'||coalesce(n.nspname,'')||':'||a.defaclobjtype::text,a.defaclrole,a.defaclacl,a.defaclobjtype FROM pg_default_acl a LEFT JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=a.defaclnamespace
 UNION ALL SELECT 'language',lanname,lanowner,lanacl,'l'::"char" FROM pg_language WHERE lanname='plpgsql'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'database',datname,datdba,datacl,'d'::"char" FROM pg_database WHERE datname=current_database())
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('raw',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(kind,ident,pg_get_userbyid(ownerid),rawacl::text) ORDER BY kind,ident),'[]') FROM objects),
 'expanded',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(o.kind,o.ident,pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable) ORDER BY o.kind,o.ident,pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable),'[]') FROM objects o CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(o.rawacl,acldefault(o.defaulttype,o.ownerid))) a));

d8_rowTypeOwners.query: SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,t.typname,pg_get_userbyid(t.typowner),t.typtype) ORDER BY n.nspname,t.typname),'[]') FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace JOIN pg_class c ON c.reltype=t.oid WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema';

d8_tableFedProbe.query: SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(id::text,uply_d8.render_label(label),uply_d8.render_label(nullable_text)) ORDER BY id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM uply_d8.samples;

d8_unsupportedFamilies.query:
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'roleComments',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(r.rolname,shobj_description(r.oid,'pg_authid')) ORDER BY r.rolname),'[]') FROM pg_roles r WHERE shobj_description(r.oid,'pg_authid') IS NOT NULL),
 'roleSecurityLabels',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(r.rolname,s.provider,s.label) ORDER BY r.rolname,s.provider),'[]') FROM pg_shseclabel s JOIN pg_roles r ON s.objoid=r.oid WHERE s.classoid='pg_authid'::regclass),
 'databaseRoleSettings',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(d.datname,r.rolname,s.setconfig) ORDER BY d.datname,r.rolname),'[]') FROM pg_db_role_setting s JOIN pg_database d ON d.oid=s.setdatabase LEFT JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=s.setrole WHERE s.setdatabase<>0),
 'parameterAcl',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(parname,paracl::text) ORDER BY parname),'[]') FROM pg_parameter_acl));

measurements.label: SOURCE_FROZEN/extensions
measurements.query:
WITH members AS (
 SELECT e.extname,d.classid,d.objid,d.objsubid,i.type,i.schema,i.identity,
 CASE d.classid WHEN 'pg_proc'::regclass THEN p.proowner WHEN 'pg_type'::regclass THEN t.typowner
 WHEN 'pg_operator'::regclass THEN o.oprowner WHEN 'pg_opclass'::regclass THEN c.opcowner
 WHEN 'pg_opfamily'::regclass THEN f.opfowner END AS ownerid,
 CASE d.classid WHEN 'pg_proc'::regclass THEN p.proacl WHEN 'pg_type'::regclass THEN t.typacl END AS rawacl,
 CASE d.classid
 WHEN 'pg_proc'::regclass THEN jsonb_build_object('definition',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'kind',p.prokind,'returnType',p.prorettype::regtype::text,'set',p.proretset,'securityDefiner',p.prosecdef,'strict',p.proisstrict,'volatility',p.provolatile,'parallel',p.proparallel,'leakproof',p.proleakproof,'language',(SELECT lanname FROM pg_language WHERE oid=p.prolang),'src',p.prosrc,'bin',p.probin,'config',p.proconfig,'argnames',p.proargnames,'argmodes',p.proargmodes,'arguments',pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid),'cost',p.procost,'rows',p.prorows)
 WHEN 'pg_type'::regclass THEN jsonb_build_object('type',t.typtype,'category',t.typcategory,'defined',t.typisdefined,'len',t.typlen,'byval',t.typbyval,'align',t.typalign,'storage',t.typstorage,'input',t.typinput::regprocedure::text,'output',t.typoutput::regprocedure::text,'receive',t.typreceive::regprocedure::text,'send',t.typsend::regprocedure::text,'typmodin',t.typmodin::regprocedure::text,'typmodout',t.typmodout::regprocedure::text,'analyze',t.typanalyze::regprocedure::text,'subscript',t.typsubscript::regprocedure::text,'element',t.typelem::regtype::text,'array',t.typarray::regtype::text,'base',t.typbasetype::regtype::text,'notnull',t.typnotnull,'default',t.typdefault)
 WHEN 'pg_operator'::regclass THEN jsonb_build_object('kind',o.oprkind,'merge',o.oprcanmerge,'hash',o.oprcanhash,'left',o.oprleft::regtype::text,'right',o.oprright::regtype::text,'result',o.oprresult::regtype::text,'code',o.oprcode::regprocedure::text,'commutator',o.oprcom::regoperator::text,'negator',o.oprnegate::regoperator::text,'restrict',o.oprrest::regprocedure::text,'join',o.oprjoin::regprocedure::text)
 WHEN 'pg_opclass'::regclass THEN jsonb_build_object('method',(SELECT amname FROM pg_am WHERE oid=c.opcmethod),'family',(SELECT format('%I.%I',n.nspname,q.opfname) FROM pg_opfamily q JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=q.opfnamespace WHERE q.oid=c.opcfamily),'input',c.opcintype::regtype::text,'key',c.opckeytype::regtype::text,'default',c.opcdefault)
 WHEN 'pg_opfamily'::regclass THEN jsonb_build_object('method',(SELECT amname FROM pg_am WHERE oid=f.opfmethod),'operators',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(a.amoplefttype::regtype::text,a.amoprighttype::regtype::text,a.amopstrategy,a.amoppurpose,a.amopopr::regoperator::text) ORDER BY a.amoplefttype::regtype::text,a.amoprighttype::regtype::text,a.amopstrategy),'[]') FROM pg_amop a WHERE a.amopfamily=f.oid),'procedures',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(a.amproclefttype::regtype::text,a.amprocrighttype::regtype::text,a.amprocnum,a.amproc::regprocedure::text) ORDER BY a.amproclefttype::regtype::text,a.amprocrighttype::regtype::text,a.amprocnum),'[]') FROM pg_amproc a WHERE a.amprocfamily=f.oid))
 END AS structure
 FROM pg_depend d JOIN pg_extension e ON e.oid=d.refobjid
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_identify_object(d.classid,d.objid,d.objsubid) i
 LEFT JOIN pg_proc p ON d.classid='pg_proc'::regclass AND p.oid=d.objid
 LEFT JOIN pg_type t ON d.classid='pg_type'::regclass AND t.oid=d.objid
 LEFT JOIN pg_operator o ON d.classid='pg_operator'::regclass AND o.oid=d.objid
 LEFT JOIN pg_opclass c ON d.classid='pg_opclass'::regclass AND c.oid=d.objid
 LEFT JOIN pg_opfamily f ON d.classid='pg_opfamily'::regclass AND f.oid=d.objid
 WHERE d.refclassid='pg_extension'::regclass AND d.deptype='e' AND e.extname<>'plpgsql'
), aclmembers AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN classid='pg_proc'::regclass THEN 'f' ELSE 'T' END::"char" AS defaulttype FROM members WHERE classid IN ('pg_proc'::regclass,'pg_type'::regclass))
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'extensions',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',e.extname,'version',e.extversion,'schema',n.nspname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(e.extowner),'relocatable',e.extrelocatable,'dependencies',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.extname ORDER BY x.extname),'[]') FROM pg_depend d JOIN pg_extension x ON x.oid=d.refobjid WHERE d.classid='pg_extension'::regclass AND d.objid=e.oid AND d.refclassid='pg_extension'::regclass),'configTables',(SELECT jsonb_agg(x::regclass::text ORDER BY ord) FROM unnest(e.extconfig) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(x,ord)),'conditions',e.extcondition) ORDER BY e.extname),'[]') FROM pg_extension e JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=e.extnamespace WHERE e.extname<>'plpgsql'),
 'members',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('extension',extname,'class',classid::regclass::text,'objectType',type,'schema',schema,'identity',identity,'subid',objsubid,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(ownerid),'structure',structure) ORDER BY extname,classid::regclass::text,identity,objsubid),'[]') FROM members),
 'rawAcl',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(extname,classid::regclass::text,identity,pg_get_userbyid(ownerid),rawacl) ORDER BY extname,classid::regclass::text,identity),'[]') FROM aclmembers),
 'expandedAcl',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(m.extname,m.classid::regclass::text,m.identity,pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee)::text END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable) ORDER BY m.extname,m.classid::regclass::text,m.identity,pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee)::text END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable),'[]') FROM aclmembers m CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(m.rawacl,acldefault(m.defaulttype,m.ownerid))) a),
 'effective',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(m.extname,m.classid::regclass::text,m.identity,r.rolname,CASE WHEN m.classid='pg_proc'::regclass THEN has_function_privilege(r.oid,m.objid,'EXECUTE') ELSE has_type_privilege(r.oid,m.objid,'USAGE') END) ORDER BY m.extname,m.classid::regclass::text,m.identity,r.rolname),'[]') FROM aclmembers m CROSS JOIN pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname<>'uply_owned_restore_admin'),
 'initialPrivileges',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('extension',m.extname,'class',m.classid::regclass::text,'identity',m.identity,'subid',ip.objsubid,'origin',ip.privtype,'raw',ip.initprivs,'expanded',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee)::text END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable) ORDER BY pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee)::text END,a.privilege_type) FROM aclexplode(ip.initprivs) a)) ORDER BY m.extname,m.classid::regclass::text,m.identity,ip.objsubid),'[]') FROM members m JOIN pg_init_privs ip ON ip.classoid=m.classid AND ip.objoid=m.objid)
);

SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'extensions',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(e.extname,e.extversion,n.nspname,pg_get_userbyid(e.extowner)) ORDER BY e.extname),'[]') FROM pg_extension e JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=e.extnamespace),

 'implementation',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(n.nspname,p.proname,oidvectortypes(p.proargtypes),pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),p.proacl::text,p.prokind,p.prorettype::regtype::text,p.proretset,p.prosecdef,p.proisstrict,p.provolatile,p.proparallel,p.proleakproof,l.lanname,p.prosrc,p.probin,p.proconfig,p.proargnames,p.proargmodes) ORDER BY n.nspname,p.proname,oidvectortypes(p.proargtypes)),'[]') FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang JOIN pg_depend d ON d.classid='pg_proc'::regclass AND d.objid=p.oid AND d.objsubid=0 AND d.deptype='e' AND d.refclassid='pg_extension'::regclass JOIN pg_extension e ON e.oid=d.refobjid WHERE e.extname='plpgsql'));

measurements.label: SOURCE_FROZEN/footprint
measurements.query:
WITH owners(kind,ident,ownerid) AS (
 SELECT 'namespace',nspname::text,nspowner FROM pg_namespace
 WHERE nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND nspname<>'information_schema'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'relation',n.nspname||'.'||c.relname,c.relowner
 FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
 WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'function',n.nspname||'.'||p.proname||'('||oidvectortypes(p.proargtypes)||')',p.proowner
 FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
 WHERE (n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema')
 OR p.oid IN (SELECT objid FROM pg_depend WHERE classid='pg_proc'::regclass
 AND refclassid='pg_extension'::regclass AND deptype='e'
 AND refobjid=(SELECT oid FROM pg_extension WHERE extname='plpgsql'))
 UNION ALL SELECT 'type',n.nspname||'.'||t.typname,t.typowner
 FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace
 WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'extension',extname::text,extowner FROM pg_extension
 UNION ALL SELECT 'language',lanname::text,lanowner FROM pg_language WHERE lanname='plpgsql'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'default',oid::text,defaclrole FROM pg_default_acl
), acls(kind,ident,acl) AS (
 SELECT 'namespace',nspname::text,nspacl FROM pg_namespace
 WHERE nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND nspname<>'information_schema'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'relation',n.nspname||'.'||c.relname,c.relacl FROM pg_class c
 JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
 WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'column',n.nspname||'.'||c.relname||'.'||a.attname,a.attacl
 FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
 WHERE a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'function',n.nspname||'.'||p.proname||'('||oidvectortypes(p.proargtypes)||')',p.proacl
 FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
 WHERE (n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema')
 OR p.oid IN (SELECT objid FROM pg_depend WHERE classid='pg_proc'::regclass
 AND refclassid='pg_extension'::regclass AND deptype='e'
 AND refobjid=(SELECT oid FROM pg_extension WHERE extname='plpgsql'))
 UNION ALL SELECT 'type',n.nspname||'.'||t.typname,t.typacl FROM pg_type t
 JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace
 WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'default',oid::text,defaclacl FROM pg_default_acl
 UNION ALL SELECT 'language',lanname::text,lanacl FROM pg_language WHERE lanname='plpgsql'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'database',datname::text,datacl FROM pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()
), refs AS (
 SELECT kind,ident,'owner'::text AS position,pg_get_userbyid(ownerid)::text AS role FROM owners
 UNION ALL SELECT kind,ident,'grantor',pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor)::text
 FROM acls CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(acl) a
 UNION ALL SELECT kind,ident,'grantee',CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee)::text END
 FROM acls CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(acl) a
 UNION ALL SELECT 'membership',roleid::text||':'||member::text,'role',pg_get_userbyid(roleid)::text FROM pg_auth_members
 UNION ALL SELECT 'membership',roleid::text||':'||member::text,'member',pg_get_userbyid(member)::text FROM pg_auth_members
 UNION ALL SELECT 'membership',roleid::text||':'||member::text,'grantor',pg_get_userbyid(grantor)::text FROM pg_auth_members
 UNION ALL SELECT 'policy',polname::text,'role',pg_get_userbyid(r)::text
 FROM pg_policy CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(polroles) r WHERE r<>0
)
SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(kind,ident,position,role)

WITH objects(kind,ident,ownerid,rawacl,defaulttype) AS (
 SELECT 'function',n.nspname||'.'||p.proname||'('||oidvectortypes(p.proargtypes)||')',p.proowner,p.proacl,'f'::"char" FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE (n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_depend d JOIN pg_extension e ON e.oid=d.refobjid WHERE d.classid='pg_proc'::regclass AND d.objid=p.oid AND d.deptype='e' AND d.refclassid='pg_extension'::regclass AND e.extname='plpgsql')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'relation',n.nspname||'.'||c.relname,c.relowner,c.relacl,CASE WHEN c.relkind='S' THEN 'S' ELSE 'r' END::"char" FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'column',n.nspname||'.'||c.relname||'.'||a.attname,c.relowner,a.attacl,'c'::"char" FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'namespace',nspname,nspowner,nspacl,'n'::"char" FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND nspname<>'information_schema'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'type',n.nspname||'.'||t.typname,t.typowner,t.typacl,'T'::"char" FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema' AND (t.typtype IN ('e','d') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_class c WHERE c.reltype=t.oid))
 UNION ALL SELECT 'default',pg_get_userbyid(a.defaclrole)||':'||coalesce(n.nspname,'')||':'||a.defaclobjtype::text,a.defaclrole,a.defaclacl,a.defaclobjtype FROM pg_default_acl a LEFT JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=a.defaclnamespace
 UNION ALL SELECT 'language',lanname,lanowner,lanacl,'l'::"char" FROM pg_language WHERE lanname='plpgsql'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'database',datname,datdba,datacl,'d'::"char" FROM pg_database WHERE datname=current_database())
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('raw',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(kind,ident,pg_get_userbyid(ownerid),rawacl::text) ORDER BY kind,ident),'[]') FROM objects),
 'expanded',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(o.kind,o.ident,pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable) ORDER BY o.kind,o.ident,pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable),'[]') FROM objects o CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(o.rawacl,acldefault(o.defaulttype,o.ownerid))) a));

n numeric;\nbegin\n  if b is null or jsonb_typeof(b)<>'object' then raise exception 'BUDGET_UNAVAILABLE'; end if;\n  foreach k in array array['maxModelCalls','maxToolExecutions','maxInputTokensPerCall','maxOutputTokensPerCall','reservedTokens','usedModelCalls','usedToolExecutions'] loop\n    if not(b ? k) or jsonb_typeof(b->k)<>'number' then raise exception 'BUDGET_UNAVAILABLE';   select 1 from public.growth_toolbox_exercises e\n      join public.course_chapters c on c.id = e.course_chapter_id\n      join public.lessons l on l.id = c.lesson_id\n      where e.id = s.id\n    )\n  ) then raise exception '老师只能向当前应用中自己负责的学生布置考试'; end if;\n  select assignment_id into v_assignment from public.curriculum_plan_assessments where plan_id = p.id and item_id = i.id;\n  if start_minute) into v_anchor from public.curriculum_plan_template_items where template_id = p.template_id;\n  v_start := p.starts_at + make_interval(mins => i.day_offset * 1440 + i.start_minute - v_anchor);\n  if v_start <= now() then raise exception '考试计划时间已经开始，请采用新计划安排未来的考试'; end if;\n  v_assignment := public.create_learning_assignment_from_paper_with_unlock(\n    i.source_id, v_course, 'selected_students', v_students, v_start,\n    v_start + make_interval(mins => i.duration_minutes), coalesce(i.instructions,''),\n    false, null, false, 1, false, false, null, null, '{}'::uuid[], and p.status in ('published','active','completed')\n    and (s.student_id = auth.uid() or (\n      private.can_manage_curriculum_plan(p.id)\n      and (public.current_profile_role() <> 'teacher' or   when 'specialized_practice' then coalesce(tp.completed,false)\n      when 'assessment_paper' then coalesce(sub.submission_state = 'grade_released' and sub.grade_released_at is not null,false)\n      else false end completed,\n    case i.source_type\n      when 'lesson' then coalesce(lp.status <> 'not_started',false)\n      when 'chapter' then ep.id is not null\n      when 'chapter_test' then is not null\n      else false end started,\n    coalesce(sub.submission_state in ('submitted_pending_grading','objective_graded_pending_manual','grading_completed'),false) pending_grading,\n    case 'published',false)\n      when 'chapter_practice' then coalesce(u.status in ('published','needs_update'),false)\n      when 'specialized_practice' then coalesce(ex.status = 'published',false)\n      when 'assessment_paper' then a.id is not null and a.status in ('published','closed')\n      else false end available,\n    case i.source_type when 'lesson' then lp.progress_percent when 'chapter' then ep.progress_percent\n      when 'chapter_practice' then pp.progress_percent else null end progress_percent,\n    a.id assignment_id, a.starts_at, a.due_at\n  from permitted p join public.curriculum_plan_template_items i on i.template_id = p.template_id\n  left join public.lessons l on i.source_type = 'lesson' and l.id = i.source_id and l.course_id = p.course_id\n  left join public.lesson_progress lp on lp.lesson_id = l.id and lp.user_id = p.student_id and lp.tenant_id = p.tenant_id\n  left join public.course_chapters ch on i.source_type = 'chapter' and ch.id = i.source_id\n  left join public.chapter_tests cht on cht.id = ch.chapter_test_id and cht.student_app_id = p.student_app_id\n  left join public.course_ebook_progress ep on ep.test_slug = cht.slug and ep.student_id = p.student_id\n    and ep.tenant_id = p.tenant_id and ep.student_app_id = p.student_app_id\n  left join public.chapter_tests test on i.source_type = 'chapter_test' and test.id = i.source_id and test.student_app_id = p.student_app_id\n  left join lateral (select bool_or(at.passed) passed, count(*) > 0 started from public.chapter_test_attempts at\n    where at.test_id = test.id and at.student_id = p.student_id and at.tenant_id = p.tenant_id) ta on true\n  left join public.chapter_practice_units u on i.source_type = 'chapter_practice' and u.id = i.source_id and u.student_app_id = p.student_app_id\n  left join public.student_chapter_practice_progress pp on pp.practice_unit_id = u.id and pp.student_id = p.student_id and pp.tenant_id = p.tenant_id\n  left join public.growth_toolbox_exercises ex on i.source_type = 'specialized_practice' and ex.id = i.source_id and ex.student_app_id = p.student_app_id\n  left join lateral (select bool_or(s.status = 'completed' and s.completed_at is not null) completed, count(*) > 0 started\n    from public.toolbox_practice_sessions s where s.exercise_id = ex.id and s.student_id = p.student_id\n      and s.tenant_id = p.tenant_id and s.started_at >= p.starts_at + make_interval(mins =>\n        i.day_offset * 1440 + i.start_minute - (select min(pi.day_offset * 1440 + pi.start_minute)\n          from public.curriculum_plan_template_items pi where pi.template_id = p.template_id))) tp on true\n  left join public.curriculum_plan_assessments ca on ca.plan_id = p.id and ca.item_id = i.id\n  left join public.learning_assignment_targets target where target.assignment_id = a.id and target.student_id = p.student_id))\n  left join lateral (select s.id,s.submission_state,s.grade_released_at from public.learning_submissions s\n    where s.assignment_id = a.id and s.student_id = p.student_id and s.tenant_id = p.tenant_id\n    order by s.attempt_number desc, s.submitted_at desc limit 1) sub on v_id uuid; v_version integer;\nbegin\n  if auth.uid() is null or not coalesce(private.is_platform_owner(),false) then raise exception '只有平台负责人可以维护结课政策'; end if;\n  select c.student_app_id into v_app from public.courses c join public.student_apps a on a.id = c.student_app_id\n    where c.id = p_course_id and a.slug = 'korean' and c.content_scope = 'platform';\n  if v_app is null or not coalesce(private.completion_policy_requirements_are_valid(p_requirements),false) then raise exception '课程或结课要求无效'; end if;\n  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(p_course_id::text, 19));\n  if p_id is not null then\n    update public.course_completion_policies set title = p_title, requirements = p_requirements\n      where id = p_id and course_id = p_course_id and status = 'draft' returning id into v_id;\n    if v_id is null then raise exception '只能修改此课程的草稿政策'; end if;\n  else\n    select coalesce(max(version),0)+1 into v_version from public.course_completion_policies where course_id = p_course_id;\n    insert into public.course_completion_policies(student_app_id,course_id,policy_code,version,title,requirements,created_by)\n      values(v_app,p_course_id,'COURSE_' || upper(replace(p_course_id::text,'-','')),v_version,p_title,p_requirements,auth.uid()) returning id into v_id;\n  end if;\n  return v_id;\nend $$;\ncreate function public.publish_completion_policy_draft(p_id uuid) returns void\nlanguage plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$\ndeclare p public.course_completion_policies%rowtype;\nbegin\n  if auth.uid() is null or not coalesce(private.is_platform_owner(),false) then raise exception '只有平台负责人可以发布结课政策'; end if;\n  select * into p from public.course_completion_policies where id = p_id;\n  if p.id is null then raise exception '政策不存在'; end if;\n  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(p.course_id::text,19));\n  select * into p from public.course_completion_policies where id = p_id for update;\n  if p.status <> 'draft' then raise exception '只能发布草稿政策'; end if;\n  -- Replacement is atomic. A validation failure rolls the retirement back too.\n  update public.course_completion_policies set status = 'retired' where course_id = p.course_id and status = 'published' and is_default;\n  update public.course_completion_policies set status = 'published', is_default = true, effective_from = now(), effective_until = null where id = p.id;\nend $$;\ncreate function public.get_completion_refresh_health() returns jsonb\nlanguage plpgsql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$\nbegin\n  if auth.uid() is null or not coalesce(private.is_platform_owner(),false) then raise exception '只有平台负责人可以查看刷新任务'; end if;\n  return (select jsonb_build_object('pending',count(*) filter(where status = 'pending'),\n    'failed',count(*) filter(where status in ('failed','partial_failed')), 'processing',count(*) filter(where status = 'processing'),\n    'lastFinishedAt',max(finished_at)) from public.course_completion_refresh_tasks);\nend $$;\ncreate function public.retry_failed_completion_refresh() returns integer\nlanguage plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$\ndeclare n integer;\nbegin\n  if auth.uid() is null or not coalesce(private.is_platform_owner(),false) then raise exception '只有平台负责人可以重试刷新任务'; end if;\n  update public.course_completion_refresh_tasks t set status='pending',available_at=now(),worker_token=null,finished_at=null\n    where t.id in (select f.id from public.course_completion_refresh_tasks f\n      where f.status in ('failed','partial_failed') and not exists(select 1 from public.course_completion_refresh_tasks a\n        where a.dedupe_key=f.dedupe_key and a.status in ('pending','processing'))\n      order by f.created_at limit 10 for update skip locked);\n  get diagnostics n = row_count;\n  return n;\nend $$;\nrevoke all on function public.save_completion_policy_draft(uuid,uuid,text,jsonb) from public,anon,authenticated;\nrevoke all on function public.publish_completion_policy_draft(uuid) from public,anon,authenticated;\nrevoke all on function public.get_completion_refresh_health() from public,anon,authenticated;\ngrant execute on function public.save_completion_policy_draft(uuid,uuid,text,jsonb) to authenticated;\ngrant execute on function public.publish_completion_policy_draft(uuid) to authenticated;\ngrant execute on function public.get_completion_refresh_health() to authenticated;\nrevoke all on function public.retry_failed_completion_refresh() from public,anon,authenticated;\ngrant execute on function public.retry_failed_completion_refresh() to authenticated;\ncommit;\n"]}, {"name": "student_teaching_content_isolation", "version": "202609140005", "statements": ["-- R2A: authenticated public content is tenant-bound; raw authoring nodes remain owner-only.\n-- Existing owner/standard-question-bank management policies are intentionally preserved.\nBEGIN;\nCREATE FUNCTION private.can_read_published_textbook(p_textbook_id uuid) RETURNS boolean\nLANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = '' AS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_tenant uuid := private.current_tenant_id();\n  v_app uuid;\n  v_category uuid;\n  v_parent uuid;\n  v_depth integer := 0;\n  v_seen uuid[] := ARRAY[]::uuid[];\nBEGIN\n  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR v_tenant IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  IF NOT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p\n    JOIN public.tenant_memberships tm ON tm.user_id=p.id\n    JOIN public.tenants t ON t.id=tm.tenant_id\n    WHERE p.id=auth.uid() AND p.status='active' AND tm.tenant_id=v_tenant\n      AND tm.status='active' AND t.status='active'\n      AND tm.role IN ('student','teacher','admin','ceo','tenant_super_admin')\n  ) THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  SELECT b.student_app_id,c.category_id INTO v_app,v_category\n  FROM public.digital_textbooks b\n  JOIN public.lessons l ON l.id=b.lesson_id\n  JOIN public.courses c ON c.id=l.course_id\n  WHERE b.id=p_textbook_id AND b.status='published' AND l.is_published AND c.is_published\n    AND b.student_app_id=c.student_app_id\n    AND ((l.content_scope='platform' AND l.tenant_id IS NULL) OR (l.content_scope='tenant' AND l.tenant_id=v_tenant))\n    AND ((c.content_scope='platform' AND c.tenant_id IS NULL) OR (c.content_scope='tenant' AND c.tenant_id=v_tenant));\n  IF NOT FOUND OR NOT private.current_user_can_read_student_app(v_app) THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  LOOP\n    IF v_category IS NULL OR v_depth >= 8 OR v_category=ANY(v_seen) THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n    SELECT c.parent_id INTO v_parent FROM public.course_categories c\n    WHERE c.id=v_category AND c.is_published AND c.student_app_id=v_app\n      AND ((c.content_scope='platform' AND c.tenant_id IS NULL) OR (c.content_scope='tenant' AND c.tenant_id=v_tenant));\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n    IF v_parent IS NULL THEN RETURN true; END IF;\n    v_seen:=pg_catalog.array_append(v_seen,v_category); v_category:=v_parent; v_depth:=v_depth+1;\n  END LOOP;\nEND;\n$$;\nALTER FUNCTION private.can_read_published_textbook(uuid) OWNER TO postgres;\nREVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION private.can_read_published_textbook(uuid) FROM PUBLIC,anon;\nGRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION private.can_read_published_textbook(uuid) TO authenticated;\n\nCREATE FUNCTION private.can_read_published_teaching_module(p_module_id uuid) RETURNS boolean\nLANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = '' AS $$\n SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (\n  SELECT 1 FROM public.digital_textbook_modules m\n  JOIN public.digital_textbook_chapters c ON c.id=m.chapter_id\n  JOIN public.digital_textbook_versions v ON v.id=c.version_id\n  WHERE m.id=p_module_id AND c.status='published' AND v.status='published'\n    AND private.can_read_published_textbook(v.textbook_id)\n );\n$$;\nALTER FUNCTION private.can_read_published_teaching_module(uuid) OWNER TO postgres;\nREVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION private.can_read_published_teaching_module(uuid) FROM PUBLIC,anon;\nGRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION private.can_read_published_teaching_module(uuid) TO authenticated;\n\n-- Close ancestor catalog surfaces as well as modules, without removing manager access.\nALTER POLICY \"authenticated read textbook catalog\" ON public.digital_textbooks\n USING (public.current_user_can_manage_standard_question_bank() OR private.can_read_published_textbook(id));\nALTER POLICY \"authenticated read textbook versions\" ON public.digital_textbook_versions\n USING (public.current_user_can_manage_standard_question_bank() OR (status='published' AND private.can_read_published_textbook(textbook_id)));\nALTER POLICY \"authenticated read textbook chapters\" ON public.digital_textbook_chapters\n USING (public.current_user_can_manage_standard_question_bank() OR (status='published' AND EXISTS (\n SELECT 1 FROM public.digital_textbook_versions v WHERE v.id=version_id AND v.status='published' AND private.can_read_published_textbook(v.textbook_id))));\nALTER POLICY \"authenticated read textbook modules\" ON public.digital_textbook_modules\n USING (public.current_user_can_manage_standard_question_bank() OR private.can_read_published_teaching_module(id));\nALTER POLICY \"authenticated read published learning agent lessons\" ON public.learning_agent_lessons\n USING (status='published' AND private.can_read_published_teaching_module(module_id));\nALTER POLICY \"authenticated read published learning agent script versions\" ON public.learning_agent_script_versions\n USING (status='published' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.learning_agent_lessons l\n WHERE l.id=lesson_id AND l.status='published' AND private.can_read_published_teaching_module(l.module_id)));\nDROP POLICY \"authenticated read published learning agent script nodes\" ON public.learning_agent_script_nodes;\n-- The existing platform-owner ALL policy remains. Student raw SELECT returns zero rows.\n\n-- Safe authored rows must be strings and reproduce the authoritative public narration.\n-- Do not expose arbitrary nested keys, invalid segment payloads, or future configuration fields.\nCREATE FUNCTION private.student_script_segments(p_script jsonb,p_segments jsonb) RETURNS jsonb\nLANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE SET search_path = '' AS $$\n SELECT coalesce(pg_catalog.jsonb_object_agg(e.key,e.value),'{}'::jsonb)\n FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_each(CASE WHEN pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(p_segments)='object' THEN p_segments ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) e\n WHERE e.key IN ('zh-CN','ko-KR') AND CASE WHEN pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(e.value)='array' THEN\n   pg_catalog.jsonb_array_length(e.value)<=50\n   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(e.value) s WHERE pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(s)<>'string')\n   AND pg_catalog.btrim((SELECT pg_catalog.string_agg(s.value,E'\\n\\n' ORDER BY s.ordinality) FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements_text(e.value) WITH ORDINALITY s),E' \\n\\r\\t')\n       =pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(p_script->>e.key,p_script->>'zh-CN',''),E' \\n\\r\\t')\n ELSE false END;\n$$;\nALTER FUNCTION private.student_script_segments(jsonb,jsonb) OWNER TO postgres;\nREVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION private.student_script_segments(jsonb,jsonb) FROM PUBLIC,anon;\nGRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION private.student_script_segments(jsonb,jsonb) TO authenticated;\n\n-- Owner-executed barrier view deliberately bypasses raw-table owner-only RLS.\n-- Every row is explicitly checked against the caller's auth.uid/current active membership.\n-- No caller-supplied user or tenant, no raw configuration column, no write grant.\nCREATE VIEW public.student_learning_agent_script_nodes WITH (security_barrier=true) AS\n SELECT n.id,n.script_version_id,n.updated_at,n.sort_order,\n   (SELECT coalesce(pg_catalog.jsonb_object_agg(e.key,e.value),'{}'::jsonb)\n    FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_each(CASE WHEN pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(n.teacher_script)='object' THEN n.teacher_script ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) e\n    WHERE e.key IN ('zh-CN','ko-KR') AND pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(e.value)='string') AS teacher_script,\n   private.student_script_segments(n.teacher_script,n.configuration->'scriptSegments') AS segments,\n   CASE WHEN n.configuration->'teacherVideo'->>'mode'='video' THEN 'video' ELSE 'legacy' END AS video_mode\n FROM public.learning_agent_script_nodes n\n JOIN public.learning_agent_script_versions v ON v.id=n.script_version_id\n JOIN public.learning_agent_lessons l ON l.id=v.lesson_id\n WHERE auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND v.status='published' AND l.status='published'\n   AND private.can_read_published_teaching_module(l.module_id);\nALTER VIEW public.student_learning_agent_script_nodes OWNER TO postgres;\nREVOKE ALL ON public.student_learning_agent_script_nodes FROM PUBLIC,anon,authenticated;\nGRANT SELECT ON public.student_learning_agent_script_nodes TO authenticated;\nCOMMENT ON VIEW public.student_learning_agent_script_nodes IS 'Caller-bound public narration only. Raw authoring configuration is never projected. StudentTeachingPolicy additionally verifies unlock, selection and revision.';\nNOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';\nCOMMIT;\n"]}, {"name": "agent_run_reconciliation", "version": "202609140006", "statements": ["-- R3A: infrastructure maintenance only. Never resumes execution.\nbegin;\n\n-- Bounded tenant sweep; terminal history does not occupy this index.\ncreate index agent_runs_reconcile_deadline on public.agent_runs(tenant_id,deadline_at,id)\n  where status in ('created','running','waiting_tool');\n\ncreate function public.find_reconcilable_agent_runs_v1(p_tenant uuid,p_limit integer default 50)\nreturns table(run_id uuid,status text,deadline_at timestamptz,lease_expires_at timestamptz,\n  cancel_requested_at timestamptz,state_version integer,fencing_token uuid)\nlanguage plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$\ndeclare cutoff timestamptz:=clock_timestamp()-interval '6 seconds';\nbegin\n  if p_tenant is null or p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 100 then raise exception 'INVALID_REQUEST'; end if;\n  return query select r.id,r.status,r.deadline_at,r.lease_expires_at,r.cancel_requested_at,r.state_version,r.fencing_token\n    from public.agent_runs r where r.tenant_id=p_tenant and r.status in ('created','running','waiting_tool')\n    and r.deadline_at <= cutoff\n    order by r.deadline_at,r.id limit p_limit;\nend $$;\n\ncreate function public.reconcile_agent_run_v1(p_tenant uuid,p_run uuid,p_expected_version integer,p_fence uuid)\nreturns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$\ndeclare r public.agent_runs; previous text; target text; reason text; stamp timestamptz; sequence bigint;\nbegin\n  if p_tenant is null or p_run is null or p_expected_version is null or p_expected_version<1 or p_fence is null\n    then raise exception 'INVALID_REQUEST'; end if;\n  select * into r from public.agent_runs where tenant_id=p_tenant and id=p_run for update;\n  if not found then return jsonb_build_object('result','not_found'); end if;\n  -- Terminal winner is immutable, even if the scanner saw an older version/fence.\n  if r.status in ('completed','failed','cancelled') then\n    return jsonb_build_object('result','already_terminal','status',r.status);\n  end if;\n  if r.state_version<>p_expected_version or r.fencing_token<>p_fence then\n    return jsonb_build_object('result','fence_conflict');\n  end if;\n  stamp:=clock_timestamp();\n  -- Admission fixes lease=deadline; no heartbeat/ownership-death guess. Deadline\n  -- already denies completion. Allow existing 3 x 2s stop-only cleanup first.\n  if r.deadline_at>stamp-interval '6 seconds' then\n    return jsonb_build_object('result','not_eligible','status',r.status);\n  end if;\n  previous:=r.status;\n  if r.cancel_requested_at is not null and r.cancel_requested_at<r.deadline_at then\n    target:='cancelled'; reason:='RUN_CANCELLED';\n  else target:='failed'; reason:='DEADLINE_EXCEEDED'; end if;\n  update public.agent_runs set status=target,state_version=state_version+1,ended_at=stamp,terminal_reason=reason\n    where id=r.id and tenant_id=p_tenant and state_version=p_expected_version and fencing_token=p_fence;\n  if not found then return jsonb_build_object('result','fence_conflict'); end if;\n  select coalesce(max(seq),0) into sequence from public.agent_run_events where run_id=r.id;\n  insert into public.agent_run_events(tenant_id,actor_id,run_id,seq,kind,metadata) values\n    (r.tenant_id,r.actor_id,r.id,sequence+1,'run.reconciled',jsonb_build_object('reason',reason,'previousStatus',previous,\n      'deadlineExceeded',true,'cancelRequested',r.cancel_requested_at is not null,'reconcilerVersion','deadline-terminal-v1')),\n    (r.tenant_id,r.actor_id,r.id,sequence+2,'run.'||target,'{}'::jsonb);\n  -- No message, usage, context, teaching data, or answer.final is written.\n  return jsonb_build_object('result','reconciled','status',target,'reason',reason);\nend $$;\n\ncreate function public.reconcile_agent_run_batch_v1(p_tenant uuid,p_limit integer default 50)\nreturns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' set lock_timeout='2s' as $$\ndeclare candidate record; outcome jsonb; outcomes jsonb:='[]'; reconciled_cancelled integer:=0;\n  reconciled_deadline_failed integer:=0;\nbegin\n  -- A single bounded transaction. Any exception rolls back the entire batch;\n  -- caller records a failed invocation, never reports a partial commit as success.\n  for candidate in select * from public.find_reconcilable_agent_runs_v1(p_tenant,p_limit) loop\n    outcome:=public.reconcile_agent_run_v1(p_tenant,candidate.run_id,candidate.state_version,candidate.fencing_token);\n    outcomes:=outcomes||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('runId',candidate.run_id)||outcome);\n    if outcome->>'result'='reconciled' then\n      if outcome->>'status'='cancelled' then reconciled_cancelled:=reconciled_cancelled+1;\n      else reconciled_deadline_failed:=reconciled_deadline_failed+1; end if;\n    end if;\n  end loop;\n  return jsonb_build_object('contractVersion','deadline-terminal-v1','results',outcomes,\n    'reconciledCancelled',reconciled_cancelled,'reconciledDeadlineFailed',reconciled_deadline_failed,'reconcileError',0);\nend $$;\n\ndo $$ declare signature regprocedure; begin\n  foreach signature in array array[\n    'public.find_reconcilable_agent_runs_v1(uuid,integer)'::regprocedure,\n    'public.reconcile_agent_run_v1(uuid,uuid,integer,uuid)'::regprocedure,\n    'public.reconcile_agent_run_batch_v1(uuid,integer)'::regprocedure] loop\n    execute format('revoke all on function %s from public,anon,authenticated,service_role',signature);\n    execute format('grant execute on function %s to service_role',signature);\n  end loop;\nend $$;\ncommit;\n"]}, {"name": "teaching_content_skeleton", "version": "202609140007", "statements": ["-- Formal from-zero authoring. No policy changes, content seed or automatic publication.\nBEGIN;\n\nCREATE FUNCTION public.create_teaching_content_skeleton(\n  p_lesson_id uuid,\n  p_expected_updated_at timestamptz,\n  p_chapter_title text,\n  p_objectives text[] DEFAULT ARRAY[]::text[]\n) RETURNS jsonb\nLANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $$\nDECLARE\n  l public.lessons%rowtype;\n  c public.courses%rowtype;\n  profile_id uuid;\n  app_slug text;\n  textbook_id uuid;\n  version_id uuid;\n  chapter_id uuid;\n  module_id uuid;\n  teaching_lesson_id uuid;\nBEGIN\n  -- Match Script Studio's existing platform-owner contract, including provisioned accounts.\n  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NOT coalesce(private.is_platform_owner(), false)\n    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_provisioned_accounts WHERE user_id = auth.uid()) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'AUTHORING_FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE = '42501';\n  END IF;\n  IF p_chapter_title IS NULL OR length(btrim(p_chapter_title)) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 120\n    OR p_objectives IS NULL OR cardinality(p_objectives) > 6\n    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(p_objectives) x WHERE x IS NULL OR length(btrim(x)) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 400) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'AUTHORING_INVALID_INPUT' USING ERRCODE = '22023';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Same lock order as existing authoring/publication triggers; serializes two HTTP sessions.\n  PERFORM runtime_publish_private.authoring_lock();\n  SELECT lesson.* INTO l FROM public.lessons lesson\n    JOIN public.courses course ON course.id = lesson.course_id\n    WHERE lesson.id = p_lesson_id FOR UPDATE OF lesson, course;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AUTHORING_RESOURCE_CHANGED' USING ERRCODE = 'PT409'; END IF;\n  SELECT * INTO c FROM public.courses WHERE id = l.course_id;\n  IF l.updated_at IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_updated_at\n    OR l.content_scope IS DISTINCT FROM c.content_scope\n    OR l.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.tenant_id THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'AUTHORING_RESOURCE_CHANGED' USING ERRCODE = 'PT409';\n  END IF;\n  -- App and profile are resolved here, never supplied by the browser.\n  SELECT slug INTO app_slug FROM public.student_apps WHERE id = c.student_app_id AND slug = 'korean' FOR SHARE;\n  IF app_slug IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AUTHORING_UNSUPPORTED_APP' USING ERRCODE = '22023'; END IF;\n  SELECT id INTO profile_id FROM public.learning_agent_profiles\n    WHERE agent_code = 'uply-korean-teacher' AND subject_code = 'korean'\n      AND access_feature = 'korean_course' AND status = 'published' FOR SHARE;\n  IF profile_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AUTHORING_PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE' USING ERRCODE = 'PT409'; END IF;\n\n  -- Includes partial and archived legacy trees. Never overwrite or silently repair them.\n  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.digital_textbooks WHERE lesson_id = l.id) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'AUTHORING_CONTENT_EXISTS' USING ERRCODE = 'PT409';\n  END IF;\n  INSERT INTO public.digital_textbooks (lesson_id, slug, level_code, title, student_app_id, agent_profile_id)\n    VALUES (l.id, 'lesson-' || l.id::text, coalesce(nullif(c.level, ''), 'unspecified'),\n      jsonb_build_object('zh-CN', l.title), c.student_app_id, profile_id) RETURNING id INTO textbook_id;\n  INSERT INTO public.digital_textbook_versions (textbook_id, version_number)\n    VALUES (textbook_id, 1) RETURNING id INTO version_id;\n  -- Chapter zero is the existing preparation-chapter contract (no chapter test required).\n  INSERT INTO public.digital_textbook_chapters (version_id, slug, chapter_number, title)\n    VALUES (version_id, 'preparation', 0, jsonb_build_object('zh-CN', btrim(p_chapter_title))) RETURNING id INTO chapter_id;\n  INSERT INTO public.digital_textbook_modules (chapter_id, module_code, sort_order, accent_role, title)\n    VALUES (chapter_id, 'orientation', 1, 'jade', '{\"zh-CN\":\"课前导航\",\"ko-KR\":\"수업 안내\"}') RETURNING id INTO module_id;\n  INSERT INTO public.learning_agent_lessons (module_id, agent_profile_id, objectives)\n    VALUES (module_id, profile_id, CASE WHEN cardinality(p_objectives) = 0 THEN '{}'::jsonb\n      ELSE jsonb_build_object('zh-CN', to_jsonb(p_objectives)) END) RETURNING id INTO teaching_lesson_id;\n  -- These existing skeleton tables have no actor columns. Script draft/node/publication\n  -- audit remains in the existing actions with auth.uid(); no fabricated actor or script.\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object('textbookId', textbook_id, 'versionId', version_id,\n    'chapterId', chapter_id, 'moduleId', module_id, 'teachingLessonId', teaching_lesson_id,\n    'profileId', profile_id, 'appSlug', app_slug, 'status', 'draft');\nEND;\n$$;\nREVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.create_teaching_content_skeleton(uuid, timestamptz, text, text[]) FROM PUBLIC, anon, service_role;\nGRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.create_teaching_content_skeleton(uuid, timestamptz, text, text[]) TO authenticated;\nCOMMIT;\n"]}, {"name": "teaching_lesson_activity_binding", "version": "202609170001", "statements": ["-- Canonical draft Activity binding. CREATE RULE "_RETURN" AS
    ON SELECT TO public.student_grade_skill_profiles DO INSTEAD  WITH latest_graded_submission AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (submission.tenant_id, submission.student_id, submission.assignment_id) submission.tenant_id,
            submission.student_id,
            submission.id AS submission_id,
            submission.assignment_id,
            submission.graded_at,
            assignment.course_id,
            assignment.student_app_id,
            assignment.source_paper_id,
                CASE
                    WHEN (assignment.assignment_type = 'exam'::text) THEN 'exam'::text
                    ELSE 'homework'::text
                END AS grade_category
           FROM (learning_submissions submission
             JOIN learning_assignments assignment ON (((assignment.tenant_id = submission.tenant_id) AND (assignment.id = submission.assignment_id))))
          WHERE ((submission.status = 'graded'::text) AND (submission.score IS NOT NULL) AND (assignment.assignment_type = ANY (ARRAY['homework'::text, 'exam'::text])))
          ORDER BY submission.tenant_id, submission.student_id, submission.assignment_id, submission.attempt_number DESC, COALESCE(submission.graded_at, submission.submitted_at) DESC, submission.id DESC
        ), scored_answer AS (
         SELECT latest.tenant_id,
            latest.student_id,
            latest.student_app_id,
            latest.course_id,
            latest.submission_id,
            latest.grade_category,
            latest.graded_at,
            answer.awarded_points,
            assignment_question.points,
                CASE
                    WHEN (lower(TRIM(BOTH FROM paper_question.skill)) ~ '(listening|listen|听力|听写|듣기)'::text) THEN 'listening'::text
                    WHEN (lower(TRIM(BOTH FROM paper_question.skill)) ~ '(speaking|speak|口语|发音|朗读|录音|말하기)'::text) THEN 'speaking'::text
                    WHEN (lower(TRIM(BOTH FROM paper_question.skill)) ~ '(reading|read|阅读|理解|읽기)'::text) THEN 'reading'::text
                    WHEN (lower(TRIM(BOTH FROM paper_question.skill)) ~ '(writing|write|写作|作文|书写|쓰기)'::text) THEN 'writing'::text
                    WHEN (lower(TRIM(BOTH FROM paper_question.skill)) ~ '(vocabulary|vocab|word|词汇|单词|字词|어휘)'::text) THEN 'vocabulary'::text
                    WHEN (lower(TRIM(BOTH FROM paper_question.skill)) ~ '(grammar|language use|语法|句法|语言运用|문법)'::text) THEN 'grammar'::text
                    WHEN (assignment_question.question_type = 'long_text'::text) THEN 'writing'::text
                    WHEN (assignment_question.question_type = 'file_link'::text) THEN 'speaking'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS skill
           FROM (((latest_graded_submission latest
             JOIN learning_submission_answers answer ON (((answer.tenant_id = latest.tenant_id) AND (answer.submission_id = latest.submission_id))))
             JOIN learning_assignment_questions assignment_question ON (((assignment_question.tenant_id = answer.tenant_id) AND (assignment_question.id = answer.question_id))))
             LEFT JOIN assessment_paper_questions paper_question ON (((paper_question.paper_id = latest.source_paper_id) AND (paper_question.sort_order = assignment_question.sort_order))))
          WHERE (answer.awarded_points IS NOT NULL)
        )
 SELECT tenant_id,
    student_id,
    student_app_id,
    grade_category,
    skill,
    (round(sum(GREATEST(awarded_points, (0)::numeric)), 2))::numeric(12,2) AS earned_points,
    (round(sum(GREATEST(points, (0)::numeric)), 2))::numeric(12,2) AS total_points,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN (sum(GREATEST(points, (0)::numeric)) > (0)::numeric) THEN round(LEAST((100)::numeric, GREATEST((0)::numeric, ((sum(GREATEST(awarded_points, (0)::numeric)) / sum(GREATEST(points, (0)::numeric))) * (100)::numeric))), 1)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END)::numeric(5,1) AS percentage,
    count(*) AS question_count,
    count(DISTINCT submission_id) AS assessment_count,
    max(graded_at) AS last_graded_at
   FROM scored_answer
  WHERE (skill IS NOT NULL)
  GROUP BY tenant_id, student_id, student_app_id, grade_category, skill;

CREATE RULE "_RETURN" AS
    ON SELECT TO public.student_learning_agent_script_nodes DO INSTEAD  SELECT n.id,
    n.script_version_id,
    n.updated_at,
    n.sort_order,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(e.key, e.value), '{}'::jsonb) AS "coalesce"
           FROM jsonb_each(
                CASE
                    WHEN (jsonb_typeof(n.teacher_script) = 'object'::text) THEN n.teacher_script
                    ELSE '{}'::jsonb
                END) e(key, value)
          WHERE ((e.key = ANY (ARRAY['zh-CN'::text, 'ko-KR'::text])) AND (jsonb_typeof(e.value) = 'string'::text))) AS teacher_script,
    private.student_script_segments(n.teacher_script, (n.configuration -> 'scriptSegments'::text)) AS segments,
        CASE
            WHEN (((n.configuration -> 'teacherVideo'::text) ->> 'mode'::text) = 'video'::text) THEN 'video'::text
            ELSE 'legacy'::text
        END AS video_mode
   FROM ((learning_agent_script_nodes n
     JOIN learning_agent_script_versions v ON ((v.id = n.script_version_id)))
     JOIN learning_agent_lessons l ON ((l.id = v.lesson_id)))
  WHERE ((auth.uid() IS NOT NULL) AND (v.status = 'published'::text) AND (l.status = 'published'::text) AND private.can_read_published_teaching_module(l.module_id));

CREATE RULE "_RETURN" AS
    ON SELECT TO public.student_learning_submission_answers DO INSTEAD  SELECT answer.id,
    answer.tenant_id,
    answer.submission_id,
    answer.question_id,
    answer.answer_text,
        CASE
            WHEN (question.auto_graded OR (submission.submission_state = 'grade_released'::text)) THEN answer.awarded_points
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS awarded_points,
        CASE
            WHEN (submission.submission_state = 'grade_released'::text) THEN answer.rubric_scores
            ELSE NULL::jsonb
        END AS rubric_scores,
        CASE
            WHEN (submission.submission_state = 'grade_released'::text) THEN answer.grader_feedback
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS grader_feedback,
    answer.created_at,
    answer.updated_at
   FROM (((learning_submission_answers answer
     JOIN learning_submissions submission ON (((submission.id = answer.submission_id) AND (submission.tenant_id = answer.tenant_id))))
     JOIN learning_assignments assignment ON (((assignment.id = submission.assignment_id) AND (assignment.tenant_id = submission.tenant_id))))
     JOIN learning_assignment_questions question ON (((question.id = answer.question_id) AND (question.assignment_id = assignment.id) AND (question.tenant_id = answer.tenant_id))))
  WHERE ((submission.student_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND private.current_student_has_app_access(assignment.tenant_id, submission.student_id, assignment.student_app_id));

CREATE RULE "_RETURN" AS
    ON SELECT TO public.student_learning_submissions DO INSTEAD  SELECT submission.id,
    submission.tenant_id,
    submission.assignment_id,
    submission.student_id,
    submission.attempt_number,
    submission.status,
    submission.submission_state,
        CASE
            WHEN (submission.submission_state = 'grade_released'::text) THEN submission.score
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS score,
        CASE
            WHEN (submission.submission_state = 'grade_released'::text) THEN submission.overall_feedback
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS overall_feedback,
    submission.submitted_at,
    submission.graded_at,
    submission.objective_graded_at,
    submission.grade_released_at
   FROM (learning_submissions submission
     JOIN learning_assignments assignment ON (((assignment.id = submission.assignment_id) AND (assignment.tenant_id = submission.tenant_id))))
  WHERE ((submission.student_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND private.current_student_has_app_access(assignment.tenant_id, submission.student_id, assignment.student_app_id));

CREATE RULE "_RETURN" AS
    ON SELECT TO public.student_toolbox_skill_profiles DO INSTEAD  WITH valid_session AS (
         SELECT session.tenant_id,
            session.student_id,
            session.student_app_id,
            session.skill,
            session.id,
            session.completed_at,
            session.active_seconds,
            session.answered_count,
            session.item_count,
            session.earned_score,
            session.max_score,
                CASE
                    WHEN (session.completed_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval)) THEN 1.0
                    WHEN (session.completed_at >= (now() - '14 days'::interval)) THEN 0.8
                    ELSE 0.6
                END AS recency_weight
           FROM toolbox_practice_sessions session
          WHERE ((session.status = 'completed'::text) AND (session.completed_at >= (now() - '30 days'::interval)) AND (session.answered_count > 0) AND (session.max_score > (0)::numeric))
        ), aggregate_profile AS (
         SELECT valid_session.tenant_id,
            valid_session.student_id,
            valid_session.student_app_id,
            valid_session.skill,
            round((sum((((valid_session.earned_score / valid_session.max_score) * (100)::numeric) * valid_session.recency_weight)) / NULLIF(sum(valid_session.recency_weight), (0)::numeric)), 1) AS accuracy_score,
            round((sum(((((valid_session.answered_count)::numeric / (GREATEST(valid_session.item_count, 1))::numeric) * (100)::numeric) * valid_session.recency_weight)) / NULLIF(sum(valid_session.recency_weight), (0)::numeric)), 1) AS completion_score,
            LEAST((100)::numeric, (((count(DISTINCT (valid_session.completed_at)::date))::numeric / (8)::numeric) * (100)::numeric)) AS consistency_score,
            sum(valid_session.answered_count) AS valid_attempts,
            count(*) AS valid_sessions,
            count(DISTINCT (valid_session.completed_at)::date) AS active_days,
            sum(valid_session.active_seconds) AS active_seconds,
            max(valid_session.completed_at) AS last_practiced_at
           FROM valid_session
          GROUP BY valid_session.tenant_id, valid_session.student_id, valid_session.student_app_id, valid_session.skill
        )
 SELECT tenant_id,
    student_id,
    student_app_id,
    skill,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN (valid_attempts >= 5) THEN round(LEAST((100)::numeric, GREATEST((0)::numeric, (((accuracy_score * 0.75) + (completion_score * 0.15)) + (consistency_score * 0.10)))), 1)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END)::numeric(5,1) AS ability_score,
    (accuracy_score)::numeric(5,1) AS accuracy_score,
    (completion_score)::numeric(5,1) AS completion_score,
    (round(consistency_score, 1))::numeric(5,1) AS consistency_score,
    valid_sessions,
    valid_attempts,
    active_days,
    active_seconds,
    last_practiced_at
   FROM aggregate_profile;
